AccountDeletionPage.confirmBody: The data listed above will be deleted right away. This can't be undone.

AccountDeletionPage.loginFirst: Please log in to the account you want to delete
AccountDeletionPage.loginHint: Use the same method you signed up with (Google or LINE). You'll come back to this page after logging in.
